# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Weekly Report (Apr 19 - 25, 2026)

## 🚀 Highlights
This week focused on hardening the stability of the Superchain infrastructure, specifically addressing race conditions and synchronization protocols. Significant progress was made in refining the **Kona-Interop** validation process and transitioning **SDM (Superchain Dependency Manager)** specifications toward the main development branch. While the team resolved several long-standing flaky tests and clarified the `op-reth` adoption path, they also navigated infrastructure hurdles related to failed Docker image builds for recent releases.

## 🛠️ Key Developments

### Protocol Stability & Node Infrastructure
Work this week centered on improving the reliability of node operations and the transition to newer execution clients.
*   **`op-reth` Adoption & Throttling:** The team clarified the deprecation plan for `op-geth` in favor of `op-reth` ([#20203](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20203)). Additionally, batcher throttling functionality was confirmed as fully supported in both `op-reth` and `op-rbuilder`, leading to the closure of related tracking issues ([#18764](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18764), [#19023](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19023)).
*   **Dependency Management:** A significant version jump for the `uuid` dependency was initiated, moving from version 9.0.0 to 14.0.0 ([#1308](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1308)).
*   **Tokenomics:** Routine maintenance was performed on the circulating supply data to ensure accurate public-facing tokenomics ([#1307](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1307)).

### Superchain & Interoperability
*   **SDM Specifications:** Work is underway to move Superchain Dependency Manager (SDM) PoC2 functionality into the `develop` branch ([#20216](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20216)), with corresponding design documentation being added to the official specifications site ([#20182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20182)).
*   **Kona-Interop Validation:** Technical discussions focused on how internally created blocks are handled during interop validation. A potential edge case was identified where missing receipts for replaced blocks could cause consolidation failures; testing is currently underway to verify this behavior ([#19266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19266)).

## 🐛 Issues & Triage

### Closed Issues
*   **Flaky Test Resolution:** Several persistent test failures were addressed. `TestInteropFaultProofs` was stabilized ([#19829](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19829)), and a draft fix was submitted for `TestRelayWithInvalidMessagesSteady` to handle transient dial timeouts ([#20254](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20254)).
*   **P2P Sync Deprecation:** The legacy `req-resp` p2p synchronization protocol in `op-node` was officially deprecated and moved to the protocol team's backlog to streamline future sync logic ([#14108](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/14108)).

### New & Active Issues
*   **Docker Build Failures:** A critical issue emerged regarding missing finalized Docker image tags for `op-reth v2.1.0`, `op-node v1.16.13`, and `kona-node v1.3.0`. Users are currently advised to use `-rc.1` images as a workaround while the build pipeline is fixed ([#20228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20228)).
*   **Sequencer Logic:** A new bug report indicates that `op-node` configured as a "sequencer LightCL" performs unnecessary engine resets on restart, potentially causing Execution Layer (EL) heads to rewind ([#20294](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20294)).
*   **Race Conditions:** Investigation into `TestSequencingWindowExpiry` revealed a race condition in `OpProofsExEx` that can lead to sequencer shutdowns. A fix involving a new write lock is currently in draft ([#20212](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20212)).

## 💬 Community & Collaboration
Collaboration this week was characterized by deep technical troubleshooting between maintainers regarding the Kona-Interop stack. The discussion in [#19266](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19266) shows active peer review and collective debugging of complex state-machine behaviors. Furthermore, the quick response to the Docker image tag failures ([#20228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/20228)) demonstrates the team's commitment to maintaining a reliable developer experience despite CI/CD challenges.
